# Theme

## Summary
Base-realm theme card: a set of CSS custom properties (and optional CSS
imports) applied to cards that select it via `cardInfo.theme`. Exported from
`https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` as `Theme`.

## API
- `cssVariables` — a `:root { --token: value; }` block; cards read tokens
  like `--background`, `--card`, `--primary`, `--foreground`, `--border`
- `cssImports` — optional list of stylesheet URLs

## Usage
Create a Theme instance, then pick it in any card's edit view under
Card Info → Theme. Hand-authored instances must include full `cardInfo`
and `cssImports` (even empty) or they will not index.

The linked example (Midnight Marker) is a working dark palette.
